page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated server instance configured with 16 vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9555 processor using the x86_64 architecture. The system features 80.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.0 GB per core, and is equipped with a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU featuring 96 GB of VRAM. This KVM-hypervised instance does not include local storage and comes with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 10%. Large-block memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only speeds reaching 444.94 GB/sec and write speeds at 279.59 GB/sec, both ranking in the top 10%. Multi-core performance is strong, as demonstrated by Geekbench multi-core and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression benchmarks. Notably, the instance delivers top-tier LLM inference speeds, processing 8554.23 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 234.73 tokens/sec for text generation on medium 7B models.

Given the inclusion of a high-capacity 96 GB VRAM Blackwell-generation GPU alongside a shared AMD EPYC CPU configuration, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile optimized for memory-intensive graphical and machine learning workloads. The absence of local storage requires external storage integration, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. This server is highly suited for medium-scale LLM inference, image processing, and GPU-accelerated compute tasks, while general database and web serving operations perform at average tier levels.
